settings.heading: Carved from a single stone
settings.subheading: Sculptural travertine furniture and objects — consoles, pedestals, basins and hearths, shaped by hand for the considered home.

settings.heading: One material, worked by hand
settings.text:
Atelier Bismuth began on Etsy with a devotion to a single, ancient material: travertine. Each piece is cut from solid stone and finished by hand — chiselled, honed, or left raw — so the grain of the earth stays visible in your home.

Every measurement is published, so the piece you imagine is the piece that arrives.
Solid travertine, Hand chiselled, One of a kind, Wabi-sabi by nature, Made to order, Built to outlast us
